shared_elements: schematic animal or bird-like figure in profile
prominent eye/disc on a head or body
rows of short parallel strokes or notches
justification: The strongest correspondence is the use of schematic profile creatures combined with linear bands of short repeated marks and eye/disc-like details. The biggest difference is that B has a clearly organized multi-register scene with several distinct animals and symbols, while A appears dominated by one eroded central creature with much less clear separation of motifs or matching relationships.
